# SRD 5.1 data (test fixture)

A trimmed copy of four files of [5e-bits/5e-database](https://github.com/5e-bits/5e-database) at
commit `a6212beb4b278917c2cff41c2b04c4ef4f3e0d6f` (`src/2014/en/`): the races dwarf, half-elf and
dragonborn, the subrace hill-dwarf, the traits they name, the Acolyte background and the monsters bandit, guard, werewolf (human form), wolf and adult red dragon, and the classes fighter, rogue and wizard with their subclasses, levels and features. The
`srd_import` test reads it.

This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1 ("SRD 5.1") by Wizards of
the Coast LLC and available at https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document. The
SRD 5.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License available at
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.
